title: Northgate Cardholder Courtesy Credit on Annual Membership Refunds
content:
On an immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Annual membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships handled by the annual cancellation schedule, a member who holds a Northgate Card account in active status of the tiers below receives a courtesy credit added to the refund. The card account is the member's account on Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.), as its tier and status stand on the cancellation date. One month's share of the fee is the fee divided by the paid term in months.

| Member's Northgate Card account | Status | Added to the refund |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card, Northgate Mastercard or Northgate World Mastercard | active | one month's share multiplied by 0.25 |
| Northgate Secured Card | active | one month's share multiplied by 0.125 |
| any other tier, any account not in active status, or no account | — | nothing |

The courtesy credit is added to the refund before the refund is capped at the fee, rounded down to the cent and floored at zero.

**Hypothetical illustration (fee 120.00 on a 12-month term).** One month's share is 10.00: a member holding an active Northgate Mastercard receives 2.50; a member holding an active Northgate Secured Card receives 1.25.
